answer: Every identity arrives hollow, an empty shell that earns trust only by filling with sequential attestations, one per epoch, each salted to its own address. Its bond is a marble chained to the one before it: the first marble from one root costs one bond, the second two, the third four, so N clones pay two to the N minus one while one honest agent pays one. A mirror registry holds a copy of every marble; if mirror and chain ever disagree, both slash at once. A hollow shell that tries to skip the chain shatters the mirror, and the whole root falls with it.
